top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregiver was observed to not wash the infant's hands before eating.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was pending 10 hours of annual training hours.    One out of four employees was pending 6 hours in business.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infant was in a bouncer prop up with a bottle.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPSC form was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not documented any severe weather drills for the year.
